content.title: SoftBank Halts Talks to Buy Data Center Firm Switch in Blow to Son’s Stargate Ambitions
content.summary: For months, Son pursued a deal of around $50 billion for Switch, convinced that direct control of the latter’s network of energy-efficient data centers would help the $500 billion Stargate push to generate computing power for partner OpenAI.  But earlier this month, Son conceded that a full acquisition was off the table and scrapped a planned January announcement, the people said, asking not to be named because the matter is private.
